title: Larry Fchella asks Grant's help with a UFO briefing for Reince Priebus
summary: Grant Cameron tells of Larry Fchella asks Grant's help with a UFO briefing for Reince Priebus, about 2016 at United States (no place named), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: anyway, he um he called me up and he said after Trump won 2016, he said, "I I need to I I need to help help. We're doing a briefing for Rance Prieous." And I said, "For what UFOs?" He said, "Where are the crafts and bodies?"

plain: A Canadian UFO researcher named Grant Cameron says that after Donald Trump won the 2016 election, a contact named Larry Fchella called him asking for help with a briefing being prepared for Reince Priebus, a senior figure on Trump's team. When Cameron asked if it was about UFOs, he says Fchella's question was: where are the crafts and bodies? If true, it would mean people near a new president were seriously asking where recovered craft and alien bodies are kept.
